name: Edinburgh Open 2013

venue.name: [University of Edinburgh](http://www.ed.ac.uk/home)
venue.address: Saturday: Teviot Row House, Bristo Square. Sunday: James Clerk Maxwell Building, Mayfield Road

information: Registration will open on Saturday 1st December at 6pm. It will close on 31st December or before if the 40 competitor limit is reached. The entry fee will be £10 for 2 days, or £5 for one day, payable on the day.
